title: AutoREC: A reinforcement learning platform for equivalent circuit model generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.27266v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper introduces AutoREC, an open-source Python platform for developing, training, and evaluating reinforcement learning (RL) agents that automatically generate equivalent circuit models (ECMs) from electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) data. Although ECMs are widely used to interpret EIS measurements, their identification typically relies on manual trial-and-error, requiring domain expertise and limiting scalability, particularly in autonomous experimental pipelines such as self-driving laboratories. In AutoREC, ECM generation is formulated as a Markov decision process in which an RL agent sequentially modifies a circuit topology based on the current state, available actions, and feedback from the resulting model. The platform supports an end-to-end workflow encompassing EIS preprocessing with selectable impedance representations, agent setup and training, ECM generation for new measurements, and visualization-based eval

translated_title: AutoREC：一个用于等效电路模型生成的强化学习平台
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了AutoREC，这是一个开源Python平台，用于开发、训练和评估强化学习（RL）智能体，该智能体能够从电化学阻抗谱（EIS）数据中自动生成等效电路模型（ECM）。尽管ECM被广泛用于解释EIS测量结果，但其识别通常依赖于手动试错，需要领域专业知识并限制了可扩展性，特别是在自动驾驶实验室等自主实验流程中。在AutoREC中，ECM生成被表述为一个马尔可夫决策过程，其中强化学习智能体基于当前状态、可用动作和所得模型的反馈，依次修改电路拓扑结构。该平台支持端到端工作流程，涵盖带可选阻抗表示的EIS预处理、智能体设置与训练、针对新测量的ECM生成以及基于可视化的评估。
tldr: 本文提出了开源Python平台AutoREC，将等效电路模型生成建模为马尔可夫决策过程，利用强化学习智能体从电化学阻抗谱数据中自动生成等效电路模型，取代了传统依赖专业知识的手动试错方法。
en_tdlr: AutoREC is an open-source Python platform that formulates equivalent circuit model generation as a Markov decision process, enabling reinforcement learning agents to automatically generate ECMs from electrochemical impedance spectroscopy data, replacing traditional manual trial-and-error approaches.
